slides.text: How to spot a prop firm *red flag*.
They like to change the rules as they go and that's something I would watch out for as a red flag.
Look at the Trustpilot reviews … see if people are getting paid out.
Make sure that you know who you're trading with, you wanna know the company, you wanna know the owner.
